summary: Frontend-only verification of the 'El recorrido completo / Tu travesía en un solo mapa' TripRouteMap section across the requested 7 routes (A-F). All reachable routes render the section (data-testid='trip-route-map') with Leaflet tiles + polyline + per-day circle markers, a right rail listing stops, etapas and km counts, and an expandable day-detail panel. Each itinerary shows its OWN distinct stops (no duplication between corridors). One requested D1 slug 404'd; the correct northern slug was found via /viajes catalog and verified.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid values when a curated route has >1 stop on the same day. data-testid='trip-route-stop-{day}' collides (e.g. /viajes/norte/ciudadesimperiales_rif/programa_6n_7d day 1 has 3 stops → 3 buttons share data-testid='trip-route-stop-1'). Same on /viajes/escapadas/marrakech and /viajes/escapadas/fez (2 buttons share testid 1 and 2). It also implies aria-controls points to a single detail id when multiple buttons share that day. Functional UI still works, but it breaks unique-selector testability and a11y assumptions.

action_items: Make data-testid uniquely identify each rail button on curated multi-stop-per-day routes. Suggested: include an index, e.g. data-testid={`trip-route-stop-${stop.day}-${idx}`} (and matching trip-route-detail-${stop.day}-${idx} / aria-controls). This avoids collisions on /viajes/norte/ciudadesimperiales_rif/programa_6n_7d and the escapadas itineraries.
Fix or remove the documented slug /viajes/norte/ciudades-imperiales/programa_4n_5d (currently 404→home). The actual catalog only exposes /viajes/norte/ciudadesimperiales_rif/programa_6n_7d.

Optional: when multiple curated stops fall on the same day, the rail visually shows the day number repeated (01, 01, 01 on Route D). Consider rendering a sub-index (1a/1b/1c) or grouping stops under one expandable day node to clarify which stop you are about to expand.
critical_code_review_comments: TripRouteMap.jsx (line 364): data-testid={`trip-route-stop-${stop.day}`} is not unique when route has multiple stops per day. Same for aria-controls and the DayDetail id. Use stable per-node index.

deriveTripRoute.js correctly produces 1 node/day and nudges duplicate coords (multi-night stays) so markers stay visible — good. KIND_TO_TYPE 'lake' falls outside TYPE_COLORS/TYPE_LABELS; ensure the legend handles it (currently it would render the raw key).

TripRouteMap.jsx renders Polyline + CircleMarker without attributionControl, which technically violates OSM/Carto attribution requirements when using carto basemaps_cartocdn tiles. Consider re-enabling minimal attribution in the corner.
MapContainer relies on `bounds`; for very short routes (2 stops very close) the auto-fit can over-zoom. Consider clamping maxZoom on boundsOptions.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (12/13 tested routes/checks PASS; 1 slug from request 404'd but a working northern route was located and verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: TripRouteMap is now present on every itinerary tested (derived where no curated route). All map-visible features work (tiles, polyline, circle markers, tooltip, etapas count, km, rail, day-detail expand/close). The main outstanding item is duplicate data-testid='trip-route-stop-{day}' on curated routes that put multiple stops on the same day (north + escapadas). The northern slug shipped in the request (/viajes/norte/ciudades-imperiales/programa_4n_5d) does not resolve; use /viajes/norte/ciudadesimperiales_rif/programa_6n_7d instead.
rca of the issue: Slug mismatch: requested D1 path uses dashed/4n_5d but only `ciudadesimperiales_rif/programa_6n_7d` exists in routing. Testid collision: rail buttons keyed by `stop.day` only, while curated routes can have multiple stops per day; tested fix is single-line change in TripRouteMap.jsx to append idx.
